## Find Specialized In-Home Care Near You
SYNERGY HomeCare of Bergen County is located at 1029 Teaneck Road, Suite 3D Teaneck, NJ 07666 and proudly serves the following areas.
The Synergy office staff (especially Rosita) is always there to help, answering any and all questions, promptly informing us of any schedule changes or any other information we may need to know.

At SYNERGY HomeCare, we build connections and forward momentum in people’s lives. We call it the Synergy Effect. We believe our purpose is to provide the best care possible. Equally important is helping people feel, see and experience more in their lives. Whether your loved one needs a little bit of help or a lot, the care they receive compassionately serves their immediate needs. But it can also have long-lasting effects that improve their lives in ways they never expected.

From personal assistance with bathing and dressing, to companion care to fight isolation and loneliness, to support with housekeeping, errand and transportation services, sometimes just a little extra help can make all the difference.
Our specialized home care services help propel people of all ages and abilities toward a happier, healthier and safer quality of life at home.

From post-surgery and hospital discharge care to care for new moms, our ConciergeCare program provides personalized and attentive transitional care focused on your safety, healing and recovery in the comfort of your home.
We’re here to help you navigate through uncharted waters and create peace of mind in caring for your loved one experiencing dementia or memory loss.
### What home care services does SYNERGY HomeCare offer?

SYNERGY HomeCare offers a full range of non-medical [home care services](https://synergyhomecare.com/nj-bergen-county-07666/home-care-services/), from companionship and help around the house to [memory care](https://synergyhomecare.com/nj-bergen-county-07666/memory-care/), [specialized care](https://synergyhomecare.com/nj-bergen-county-07666/specialized-care/) for chronic conditions and disabilities, and recovery support after a hospital stay. Your local office can help you determine the services right for your situation.
### How much does home care cost in SYNERGY HomeCare of Bergen County?

The cost of home care depends on the services you need and how many hours of support you want, so pricing starts with a free, no-obligation in-home assessment. Long-term care insurance, some Medicare Advantage plans, and VA benefits may help cover the [cost](https://synergyhomecare.com/nj-bergen-county-07666/paying-for-care/). Your SYNERGY HomeCare team will walk you through straightforward pricing with no hidden fees.
### Can I help choose the caregiver and meet them in advance?

Often within days. After a no-obligation in-home assessment, SYNERGY HomeCare of Bergen County matches you with a caregiver based on your needs, schedule, and personality, and in urgent situations we work to begin care as quickly as possible.
